name: Con-Reg courier
text: A Con-Reg courier skiff on the emergency band, one engine out. Her hold is full of paper filed again from Depot 4's backups, and yours is in there somewhere.

outcomes.result: Her pilot opens the hold for a tow and doesn't watch what goes out the airlock. Con-Reg's paper on you is a cloud of confetti.
Her pilot did watch. The argument costs someone a bruise, and the paper goes out the airlock all the same.

choices.label: Keep flying
choices.result: Someone else will tow her. Your paper will get where it's going.
